title: Verify: Retry returns to the loading state and reloads unit tests
summary: Unit tests for Retry loading state and refetch
description: Test that after Retry the loading message shows while pending, listMine is called twice, and a second failure shows the error again.
acceptance_criteria: Pending retry shows loading and hides error and Retry
Second rejection shows error and Retry again
technical_constraints: Use a manually controlled promise for the second listMine call; no real network

steps.action: Create jsdom test file with the same vi.mock of ../src/api/client as tests/contributionHistoryRetry.test.tsx. Test 'shows loading while retry pending': first listMine rejects, second returns a never-resolving promise; click Retry; assert getByText('Loading your suggestions…') present, queryByText('Could not load your suggestions') null, queryByRole('button',{name:'Retry'}) null, listMine called 2 times. Test 'second failure shows error again': mockRejectedValueOnce twice; click Retry; assert findByRole('alert') has the error text and Retry button is present again.
